name: accounts_payable_pulse
description: AP health dashboard and invoice lookup for Accounts Payable teams. Two modes: (1) AP Pulse Briefing — comprehensive AP payments health snapshot: overdue invoices with age buckets, holds, match exceptions, approval pipeline aging, large upcoming payments, with optional cash balances, intake trend, and team performance; opens with AI-synthesized Key Takeaways. (2) Invoice Lookup — match uploaded supplier invoices (CSV/Excel/PDF) against system records to verify amounts, currency, and payment status. Triggers: AP pulse, AP dashboard, AP health, good morning AP, AP briefing, how are my invoices, AP status, payments health, match this invoice, check invoice status, reconcile invoices, upload invoice.
